findings.text: non-blocking: this pre-existing control test is outside the node's declared write paths and its assertion was inverted from a queued-launch refusal to a direct-dispatch refusal, so the node edits a test it was not fenced to write and needs the coordinator to confirm the extension.

non-blocking: the base arm ran 21 tests in a four-file set where the head arm ran 461 in 67 files and the log header names no command, so the done-when's add-no-failure-against-base clause is evidenced only by the three head failure ids recurring at base rather than by a same-population base run.

non-blocking: the done-when's ruff clause is named in no test_logs or artifacts entry, so the "All checks passed! 4 files already formatted" result that exists only in the run stream cannot be replayed from the receipt.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 2960ad4da8; 1bd720c73e changes two product lines plus the new test and the control test, and 68980b1f70 adds the 57-line evidence fragment, with nothing else touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/test_a_queued_launch_ignores_the_coordinator_backlog.py with three cases plus a negative control and a ruff clause; the three cases are at :193, :214 and :234, gate-head-arm.log ends "3 failed, 458 passed" EXIT=1 with each failing id present in gate-base-four.log, and negative-control.log ends "1 failed, 2 deselected" EXIT=1, but the ruff clause carries no log of its own.

item_verdicts.manifest: read at status complete with commits 1bd720c73e and 68980b1f70; it quotes the base reproduction, the waiver shape on the launched pointer, the head and base gate figures and the negative control, and declares the out-of-scope control test under outside_scope.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node declared reckon/crew/queue_admission.py, reckon/crew/dispatch.py, its evidence fragment and its figures directory; git diff --stat 2960ad4da8..68980b1f70 shows five changed files, of which tests/test_a_queued_launch_ignores_the_coordinator_backlog.py and tests/test_a_review_is_not_refused_for_its_run.py are outside that declaration.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_queued_launch_ignores_the_coordinator_backlog.py:193-211 fails with an empty launched list when reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:412 is restored to the stored flag, as negative-control.log records, and :234-242 fails if the "and unreconciled" guard at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1866 is dropped.
justifications.evidence: gate-head-arm.log and gate-base-four.log each end in EXIT= and yield an added-failure count of 0 through reckon/crew/review.py:added_failures_from_gate_logs, but the base arm covers only 21 tests against the head arm's 461 and the done-when's ruff clause is recorded only in the run's stream.
justifications.fit: the two product edits follow the surrounding comment-before-field idiom of reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1848-1865 and no symbol, path or comment carries a plan or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:412 removes the launch-time refusal and reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1859 records source "admission-launch" with the waived runs, while reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1863-1866 still raises for a dispatch that carries no override.
justifications.reuse: no definition is added; the change extends the existing waiver record at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1854 and reuses the existing admission_launch parameter at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1497, and a search of reckon/crew for another unreconciled-waiver owner found none.
justifications.scope_discipline: tests/test_a_review_is_not_refused_for_its_run.py:129 was rewritten although it is absent from the declared write paths in the run's committed node record.
